snippet.title: IRON CURTAIN CALL — Official Trailer | WW3: Third Time’s the Charm
snippet.description:
World War III, run like a customer service department. Meet the robot armies and very undiplomatic weapons of Iron Curtain Call in the trailer.

Looking for a Cuphead style FPS? Iron Curtain Call is a fast cartoon noir FPS in a 1930s rubber hose style. The demo is free on Steam. If you like ULTRAKILL, you may like Iron Curtain Call, a fast cartoon noir FPS in a 1930s rubber hose style. The demo is free on Steam.

The free Steam demo includes Mission 1 only. Full game release on March 11, 2027.

Play the free demo and wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5417460/Iron_Curtain_Call/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=iron-curtain-call&utm_content=yt-official-trailer

Website: https://ironcurtaincall.com

AI disclosure. The game uses AI tools for voice acting, some art and some music.

Iron Curtain Call is an independent game with no connection to Cuphead or its makers. Iron Curtain Call is an independent game with no connection to ULTRAKILL or its makers.

#FPS #ULTRAKILL #Cuphead
